APP.TITLE: new-api-sync
APP.SUBTITLE: Sync pricing, channels, and models from upstream providers.
HEALTH.TITLE: Server health
HEALTH.DESCRIPTION: Runtime status of the sync server.
SYNC.TITLE: Sync pipeline
SYNC.DESCRIPTION: Run a full sync, test provider connectivity, or reset managed resources.
SYNC.EMPTY_IDLE: No run yet. Click Run, Test, or Reset to start.
CONFIG.TITLE: Configuration
CONFIG.DESCRIPTION: Edit providers, pricing, and global settings. Saving re-validates the YAML; an invalid document is rolled back automatically.
CONFIG.TARGET.TITLE: Target
CONFIG.TARGET.DESCRIPTION: The new-api instance that receives the synced channels and models.
CONFIG.GLOBAL.TITLE: Global settings
CONFIG.GLOBAL.DESCRIPTION: Apply to every provider unless overridden per-provider.
CONFIG.GLOBAL.TEST_MODEL_TYPES_HELP: When set, only these model types are tested. Leave off for default (text only).
CONFIG.GLOBAL.BLACKLIST_HELP: Model names or globs to exclude from every provider.
CONFIG.GLOBAL.MODEL_MAPPING_HELP: Rename upstream models before they land in the target.
CONFIG.PROVIDERS.TITLE: Providers
CONFIG.PROVIDERS.DESCRIPTION: Each provider pushes channels into the target. Order matters: later providers override earlier ones on conflict.
CONFIG.PROVIDERS.CONFIRM_DELETE_DESC: This removes the provider from this config. The target will be cleaned up on the next sync.
CONFIG.PROVIDER.NAME: Name
CONFIG.VALIDATION.FAILED: Configuration is invalid. Fix the highlighted fields before saving.
HISTORY.TITLE: Run history
HISTORY.DESCRIPTION: Past sync runs and their summaries, stored in logs/.
HISTORY.COMING_SOON: coming soon: list of past runs with diff and report
